decisions.reason: Escalation of commitment makes management reluctant to drop a core encrypted communication channel after four years of investment, despite limited visible promotion.
Its dedicated website page signals public commitment and its centrality to the secure identity direction justifies continuing, so drop probability is low.
Hardware authentication fits the firm's directed secure ecosystem and its dedicated page shows commitment, making a drop unlikely.
Although payment compliance is less central than core identity products, sunk costs and public mention push management to keep it for now.
